name: upgrade-implementation-pending
body: Tier-4 for this feature is not authored yet. No upgrade code exists on this branch: there is no `upgrade` symbol in the scanned graph, internal/cli.Run dispatches exactly init, init-library, start, templates, version and help, and internal/scaffold has no upgrade entry point. The plan-writer declares the planned Implementation nodes at plan time (an `internal/cli.runUpgrade` and a new `internal/scaffold` upgrade entry point); the single `implemented-by` edge attached to solution.component.upgrade targets the existing `internal/cli.Run` dispatch the command is registered in, and is intentionally the only existing-code edge [autonomous].
